name: Doro
description: A festive, slow-cooked spicy chicken stew simmered in rich berbere spice blend and authentic spiced butter, traditionally accompanied by a hard-boiled egg.

name: Chechebsa
description: Shredded, pan-fried kitcha flatbread tossed softly in fragrant niter kibbeh spiced butter and a touch of berbere, served warm.

name: Chips
description: Crispy, golden-fried potato chips seasoned lightly with salt, perfect as a quick snack or a crunchy side dish.

name: Burger
description: A juicy, grilled beef patty layered inside a soft bun with crisp lettuce, fresh tomatoes, onions, and signature house sauce.

name: Dulet
description: A traditional, finely minced breakfast mixture of lean beef, tripe, and liver sautéed with spiced butter, garlic, and hot green peppers.

name: Fetira
description: Crispy, layered pastry flatbread served warm, commonly enjoyed drizzled with sweet honey or cooked with an egg filling.

name: IceCream
description: Smooth and creamy chilled ice cream, offering a sweet and refreshing finish to clear the palate after a spicy meal.

name: Kategna
description: Toasted injera layers brushed generously with aromatic spiced butter and fiery berbere, offering a crispy, savory, and spicy bite.

name: Kitfo
description: Finely minced extra-lean beef warmed gently in mitmita spice and pure niter kibbeh, typically served raw, rare, or lightly cooked.

name: KuantaFirfr
description: Savory strips of dried beef jerky (kuanta) simmered into a spicy berbere sauce, tossed thoroughly with shredded, moist pieces of injera.

name: Lasagna
description: Layers of tender pasta sheets baked beautifully with a savory minced meat sauce, rich béchamel, and melted gooey cheese.

name: Mahberawi
description: A grand, celebratory combination platter featuring an assortment of key meat dishes like tibs, wot, and kitfo served together over injera.

name: Mojitto
description: A refreshing, ice-cold mocktail made with muddled fresh mint leaves, tart lime juice, sugar, and sparkling soda.

name: Noodle
description: Stir-fried noodles cooked with crisp seasonal vegetables, savory soy sauce, and a spicy kick of fresh green chilies.

name: Pasta
description: Al dente pasta served with your choice of a rich, slow-simmered tomato marinara sauce or a flavorful minced meat bolognese.

name: Pizza
description: Freshly baked pizza dough topped with a rich tomato baseline sauce, a heavy layer of melted mozzarella, and your favorite meat or veggie toppings.

name: RawMeat
description: Premium, fresh cuts of high-quality raw beef served in traditional style, accompanied by sharp mitmita powder and senafich (mustard) sauce.

name: Salad
description: A crisp, light salad of fresh lettuce, tomatoes, red onions, and green peppers tossed in a simple lemon and olive oil vinaigrette.

name: Shake
description: A thick, velvety milkshake blended with premium dairy and your choice of flavorings, topped with whipped cream.

name: Shekla
description: Sizzling meat strips cooked with onions, garlic, and green chilies, served hot directly inside a traditional clay pot (shekla) with burning charcoal beneath.

name: Smoothy
description: A refreshing blend of fresh seasonal fruits like mango, avocado, and papaya layered together beautifully in a chilled glass.

name: Tegabino
description: A thick, savory clay-pot preparation of spiced chickpea powder (shiro) simmered rapidly with oil, onions, and boiling water.

name: Tibs
description: Tender cubes of beef or lamb sautéed quickly with sliced onions, minced garlic, aromatic rosemary branches, and mild green peppers.
